title: AFOSI founding director a devout Catholic; AFOSI behind early Collins Elite

tellings.quote: the founding director of Air Force Office of Special Investigations was a devout Catholic who wanted to go to seminary and suddenly found himself in intelligence.

plain: On Jesse Michels's podcast, a guest named Jason Samosa says that the first director of the Air Force Office of Special Investigations, the US Air Force's own investigative agency formed around 1948, was a devout Catholic who had wanted to train as a priest and suddenly found himself working in intelligence. In his telling, that office was behind the early days of a group known as the Collins Elite, which would suggest religious belief shaped how parts of the government handled UFOs.
